projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: The Producer Portal is deployed to Production and technically ready. Premera planned a big-bang rollout to 2,500+ producers on 22-Oct-2026. ALT lists this as a WATCHLIST item with an explicit deployment risk.
riskDescription.condition: If an issue is encountered during the mass producer onboarding, the rollout may need to be rolled back and remediated.
riskDescription.consequence: Rollback would delay producer access to the portal, damage client confidence, and require emergency remediation effort under time pressure.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement phased rollout with pilot cohort of 50 producers before mass onboarding to validate integration and performance.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon critical defect detection during onboarding, activate rollback procedure and engage backup manual registration process within 4 hours.
risks.reasoning: Carried forward from ALT (23-Oct-2026) as an open deployment risk. Big-bang rollout approach (2,500+ users) increases blast radius. No staged rollout or pilot phase documented. Production validation completed with only 11 users; scale testing gap exists.

riskDescription.context: The project has absorbed 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75–1 sprint of additional effort as of 29-Jun-2026. EMS Risk R857 is Identified with mitigation status Assessed but no finalized mitigation plan.
riskDescription.condition: Further scope additions may continue to be absorbed without formal change control, compressing remaining buffer and increasing delivery pressure.
riskDescription.consequence: Margin erosion, team burnout, or quality shortcuts could result if scope creep continues unmanaged.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal change request procedure with impact assessment and client approval before accepting any new scope additions.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When cumulative scope changes exceed 1 sprint effort, escalate to program leadership and negotiate timeline extension or scope deferral.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk R857 (Identified, Assessed, no mitigation plan finalized). WSR Scope Change Tracker shows 14 changes absorbed without formal CR as of 22-Jul-2026, violating Work Assignment Section 14 assumption. Change Management process defined but not invoked.

riskDescription.context: Citrix server slowness and frequent disconnections have been impacting offshore team delivery since at least 22-Jul-2026. WSR lists this as an open issue with no ETA. EMS go-green plan includes raising a Citrix ticket with Premera.
riskDescription.condition: If Citrix performance is not resolved, offshore team productivity may remain degraded, extending effort and delaying remaining work.
riskDescription.consequence: Increased cost due to prolonged effort, potential missed milestones, and team frustration.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Escalate Citrix performance ticket to Premera IT with dedicated support coverage during offshore hours to resolve connectivity issues.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Citrix slowness persists beyond one week, reprioritize tasks to non-Citrix-dependent activities and engage onshore resources for critical work.
risks.reasoning: Open issue in WSR (22-Jul-2026) with no ETA. Corroborated by EMS go-green plan. Offshore team is a significant portion of the delivery team; prolonged degradation affects sprint velocity and quality.

riskDescription.context: Data mapping values for Data Hub integration were still being discussed as of 25-Jun-2026. WSR Decision #31 notes the team is proceeding with defined mappings, but if issues with values lead back to design (entity stitching), there may be time impact.
riskDescription.condition: Misalignment in data mapping or entity stitching may surface during E2E testing or post-deployment, requiring rework of integration logic.
riskDescription.consequence: Late-stage rework could delay stabilization, increase defect count, and weaken client trust in data accuracy.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct weekly data mapping validation sessions with Data Hub and business teams to confirm entity stitching before E2E testing.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If data misalignment is detected during E2E testing, rebaseline impacted scope and agree phased delivery with Premera to protect rollout.
risks.reasoning: Open risk in WSR Risk Register (25-Jun-2026) with ETA 15-Jul-2026. Data mapping discussions ongoing as of 25-Jun-2026. ALT shows Production deployed 23-Oct-2026, but upstream data setup for Integration/E2E testing was pending as of 22-Jul-2026. Risk of misalignment remains.

riskDescription.context: As of 22-Jul-2026, backend code coverage is 57% (target 80% per Work Assignment), 190 code smells exist (2 Critical, 80 Major), and 86 CVEs are detected (4 Critical, 82 High) on Alpine base image.
riskDescription.condition: Unresolved code quality issues and low unit test coverage may allow defects to reach Production, especially under the pressure of a big-bang rollout.
riskDescription.consequence: Post-deployment defects could trigger rollback, emergency patches, or client escalation.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Enforce quality gate requiring 80% backend coverage and critical code smell resolution before ACPT deployment with senior developer reviews.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon production defect detection, activate emergency patch process and deploy hotfix within 24 hours with expedited testing and client communication.
risks.reasoning: WSR Sprint Demo PI4 Sp3 (22-Jul-2026) shows persistent code quality issues and BE coverage gap. ALT deployment risk (big-bang rollout) amplifies the impact of latent defects. No evidence of quality gate enforcement or remediation plan in provided artifacts.

riskDescription.context: SCA scans as of 22-Jul-2026 detected 86 CVEs (4 Critical, 82 High) on Alpine base image. No remediation plan or timeline is documented in the provided artifacts.
riskDescription.condition: Unpatched critical and high-severity vulnerabilities may remain in the Production environment, exposing the platform to security threats.
riskDescription.consequence: Security audit findings could delay client sign-off, trigger compliance penalties, or result in a security incident post-deployment.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Remediate all critical CVEs and upgrade Alpine base image before production deployment with penetration test validation post-UAT.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should security audit fail, implement virtual patching via WAF rules and isolate vulnerable components until patches are deployed within 48 hours.
risks.reasoning: WSR Sprint Demo PI4 Sp3 (22-Jul-2026) shows 86 CVEs (4 Critical, 82 High). No remediation plan or timeline documented. Penetration testing was planned post-UAT (WSR Decision Log #20), but no results or remediation status is available in the provided artifacts as of 23-Oct-2026.

riskDescription.context: AAVA adoption remains low with no formal adoption plan. Tool integration delays (AAVA 2.0 SharePoint, Azure Blob, ADO access pending as of 15-Jun-2026) caused refactoring effort (Change #7). WSR Risk Register lists open agent-related risks (Single LLM, Tools Integration, Agent Hardening, Agent Learning, Client Template Alignment, Tool/API Invocation Failures, Agent Orchestration).
riskDescription.condition: Low AAVA adoption and unresolved agent framework risks may limit productivity gains, increase manual effort, and introduce inconsistent agent behavior in Production.
riskDescription.consequence: Reduced ROI on AAVA investment, increased support burden, and potential client dissatisfaction with agent-driven features.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Define AAVA adoption roadmap with hardening checklist and fallback logic for agent failures before production agent deployment.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If agent behavior is inconsistent in production, switch to manual processes and escalate to AAVA support for troubleshooting within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Multiple open risks in WSR Risk Register (16-Mar-2026, 09-Mar-2026, 17-Mar-2026) with no ETA. AAVA 2.0 tool integration dependency (Dep #20) pending as of 15-Jun-2026. Scope Change #7 documents refactoring due to tool integration delays. No formal adoption plan or hardening checklist documented.

riskDescription.context: Auth0 terraform release pipeline support is listed as an open issue in WSR (22-Jul-2026) with no ETA. Premera team must provide continued support if any issue arises.
riskDescription.condition: If Auth0 configuration changes are required post-deployment and Premera support is unavailable or delayed, identity and access management issues may block producer access.
riskDescription.consequence: Producer onboarding delays, support escalations, and potential rollback if authentication failures occur at scale.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Secure dedicated Auth0 support contact from Premera with escalation path and document terraform pipeline runbook before production deployment.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon Auth0 configuration failure, engage Premera escalation contact immediately and activate manual user provisioning workaround to maintain onboarding continuity.
risks.reasoning: Open issue in WSR Support Required (22-Jul-2026) with no ETA. Auth0 DB connection config dependency was previously closed (08-Jul-2026), but terraform pipeline support remains open. Single-source indication, but high impact if authentication issues occur during mass producer onboarding.

riskDescription.context: Upstream data setup for Integration and E2E testing was pending as of 22-Jul-2026 (WSR Support Required) with no ETA. ALT shows Production deployment completed 23-Oct-2026, but E2E validation was limited to portal-only, persona-based testing with 11 users.
riskDescription.condition: Insufficient end-to-end testing with live upstream data (Edge, Data Hub) may allow integration defects to surface during mass producer onboarding.
riskDescription.consequence: Post-deployment defects could trigger rollback, emergency patches, or client escalation.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Prioritize upstream data setup with Edge and Data Hub teams and execute full E2E integration testing before production deployment.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon integration defect detection post-deployment, execute limited testing in available environments and deploy hotfix within 48 hours with expedited validation.
risks.reasoning: Open dependency in WSR Support Required (22-Jul-2026) with no ETA. ALT shows E2E validation completed with only 11 users; scale testing gap exists. Big-bang rollout (2,500+ users) amplifies the impact of untested integration scenarios.

riskDescription.context: The project is a Fixed Bid engagement ($650,000 NTE) with milestone-based payments. 14 scope changes have been absorbed without formal CR as of 29-Jun-2026, and the project end date was extended from 31-Aug-2026 to 31-Dec-2026 (EMS).
riskDescription.condition: If additional scope changes or timeline extensions are required, the Fixed Bid model may not cover the effort, leading to margin erosion or client disputes over additional charges.
riskDescription.consequence: Financial loss for Ascendion or client dissatisfaction if additional charges are contested.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Invoke formal change control procedure for all new scope requests with cost and timeline impact assessment before client approval.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If margin erosion exceeds 10%, escalate to program leadership and negotiate change order or scope deferral with Premera within one week.
risks.reasoning: Fixed Bid model (Work Assignment) combined with 14 absorbed scope changes (WSR Scope Change Tracker) and timeline extension (EMS: 31-Aug-2026 to 31-Dec-2026). No formal CR raised despite Work Assignment Section 14 requirement. Risk of margin erosion or client dispute.

riskDescription.context: QE resource Kishore transitioned out effective 01-May-2026 and was replaced with a Playwright + TypeScript resource (WSR Decision Log #1, 04-Aug-2026). No dedicated DevOps resource is planned; David from AI Platform Build Claims POD provides on-need IaC/DevOps support (WSR Decision Log #2, 14-Apr-2026).
riskDescription.condition: If David's availability is constrained or if additional DevOps support is required post-deployment, infrastructure or deployment issues may not be resolved promptly.
riskDescription.consequence: Delayed incident resolution, prolonged downtime, or escalation during Hypercare.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Cross-train team members on IaC and DevOps tasks and document runbooks for common deployment and infrastructure operations.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If David is unavailable during incident, engage Premera DevOps team and monitor incident resolution to ensure timely closure.
risks.reasoning: Single-source indication from WSR Decision Log (14-Apr-2026). No evidence of DevOps bottleneck or incident in provided artifacts. Talent RAG is Green in EMS. Likelihood is low, but impact is medium if issue occurs during Hypercare.

riskDescription.context: UAT test cases early delivery was listed as an open support request in WSR (22-Jul-2026) with no ETA. Work Assignment assumes UAT stakeholders are nominated and available per timeline.
riskDescription.condition: If UAT test cases are not delivered early or if UAT stakeholder availability is constrained, UAT execution may be delayed or incomplete, allowing defects to reach Production.
riskDescription.consequence: Post-deployment defects, client dissatisfaction, or rollback if critical issues are discovered late.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Secure UAT test case delivery commitment from Premera by 01-Aug and confirm stakeholder availability for UAT execution window.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If UAT test cases are delayed, prioritize business-critical scenarios and execute limited UAT to validate core functionality before deployment.
risks.reasoning: Open support request in WSR (22-Jul-2026) with no ETA. ALT shows Production deployment completed 23-Oct-2026, suggesting UAT was completed. Single-source indication with no evidence of UAT delay or defect leakage in provided artifacts. Likelihood is low.
